explanation: It is painted in oil on a thin panel of poplar wood, as many Italian paintings of its time were. Over the centuries the panel has warped slightly.

claims.text: The Mona Lisa is painted in oil on a poplar wood panel, not on canvas.
Poplar panels were commonly used for Italian paintings in Leonardo's time.
The Mona Lisa's poplar panel has warped slightly over time.
